job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed hbm_stn_mcast_r6b_f78eb159f (hfd_mcast_r6b, RTL f78eb159f, snapshot of 2 drifted files): same RTL, outline 466.968x120.936, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:hbm-views

benches.name: bench_mcast_exact_and_negatives
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/hfd_mcast_r6b_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/hfd_mcast_r6b_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { bash physical/hbm_accel_die_views/stations/bench/run_mcast_bench.sh $PWD/physical/hbm_accel_die_views/stations hfd_mcast_r6b $PWD {RUN}/bench
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the f78eb159f snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/hfd_mcast_r6b_m5/src]

benches.name: bench_neg_generator_mutant
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_1; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/hfd_mcast_r6b_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/hfd_mcast_r6b_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { grep -q '^neg rc=1' {RUN}/bench/hfd_mcast_r6b/result.txt && echo NEG_DETECTED && exit 1
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the f78eb159f snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/hfd_mcast_r6b_m5/src]
